Pinned browser terminal dependencies, distributed under their included licenses.

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0.
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0 (MIT).
- `roboto-mono-*.woff2`: Latin normal/bold from `@fontsource/roboto-mono` 5.3.0 (OFL).

Source distributions are available from the package registry. Fetch updates through
the configured dependency proxy and copy the package library, CSS, and license files.
